## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/date-range-picker`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`DateRangePickerComponent`](/api/date-range-picker/DateRangePickerComponent) | Component | Picks a range of days: two inputs for its first and last day, typed in the locale's format, and a calendar popup that shows two months at a time. |
